data.title: Income tax assessment for 2025 (Bescheid über Einkommensteuer)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow assessed Frauke Beispielrade's income tax for 2025 and determined a refund (Guthaben) of €715.00, to be transferred to her bank account. The letter also explains her right to file an objection (Einspruch) against the assessment.
data.explanation: This is your 2025 income tax decision from the Finanzamt. Based on your income, work expenses and special expenses, you overpaid tax and will receive a refund of €715.00 to the account shown. No action is needed to get the refund. If you disagree with how the tax office calculated anything (for example the rejected home office/Arbeitszimmer costs), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows until when you can do this. If you miss that window, the assessment becomes final.
data.tax_note: This is the official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 itself and should be kept with tax records; it also documents that home office expenses were handled via the Tagespauschale rather than the Arbeitszimmer deduction.
